notes: MADToken is a fixed-supply ERC-20 with 18 decimals. Its constructor takes no arguments and mints 1,000,000,000 MAD once to msg.sender, the factory at launch. It has no owner, subsequent minting, pause, blacklist or transfer fees. There are no application contracts. The pool pairs MAD with FWA. pool.initialPrice records provenance only; the deployer derives the opening price from economics.initialMarketCapWei and token.totalSupply.
